impact: No relief from the Fed for rate-sensitive growth names like NBIS, PLTR and HOOD; the December hike bet stays in place.
summary: Fed Chair Warsh opened the Fed's Productivity and Jobs Task Force conference in San Francisco on Monday with remarks on AI and productivity, saying nothing about the next rate move, inflation or the balance sheet. Markets still price a December 25bp hike, with the 2-year yield near 4.86%.
title: Fed Chair Warsh gives AI and productivity speech, no rate signal
